config.name: arch-bakeoff
config.stage: offline (existing data only; no new data generation)

data.same_as: value-v2-100k-aug-b (identical roots, point end_turn, stride 3, split train 2650000+95000 / test 2745000+5000)
data.extra_targets: winner seat and final turn from each game record (per-row seat = argmax of the encoder-v2 absolute-seat one-hot; consistency check: relative winner == 0 iff y == 1 on every row)

common.augment: one of the 12 hex symmetries per row per batch (encoder-v2 permutation applied before any structuring)
common.epoch_selection: lowest validation BCE of P(I win) on the last 5,000 train games; never test

arms.base: residual MLP exactly as value-v2-100k-aug-b (1324 -> 512, 3 residual blocks, dropout .1, LayerNorm head), single sigmoid P(I win), retrained here with the common settings as the paired reference
arms.heads: same trunk as base; heads: (a) 4-way softmax over the winner's seat relative to me (cross-entropy, weight 1; P(I win) = p[me]); (b) turns remaining until the game ends / 100, Huber, weight 0.1 (auxiliary only). Shengji precedent: richer deciding target helped, auxiliary heads only as training targets
arms.tiles: tile-token transformer: 19 tile tokens (tile features + its 6 corners' vertex features + its 6 sides' edge features, Settlers-RL style), 4 player tokens (seat-relative), 1 global token; learned type/position embeddings; 4 pre-norm encoder layers, d 128, 4 heads, MLP 256, dropout .1; P(I win) from the global token
arms.cnn: hex-grid CNN (AlphaGo-style board planes): vertices, edges and tile centres placed on a 2D grid from the fixed board coordinates (26 channels: tile 8 + vertex 14 + edge 4), 6 residual 3x3 conv blocks, 64 channels, global average + max pool, concatenated with the per-player and global features into a 256 MLP head; P(I win)

gate.primary: per arm vs base, on the 5,000 test games' rows (paired, same rows): AUC(arm) - AUC(base) >= +0.010 with game-clustered bootstrap 95% LCB > 0 (1,000 resamples, seed 29)
gate.reported: test AUC and log loss of every arm; calibration (10-bin ECE); parameters; train seconds; for heads, the 4-way log loss
gate.next: Arms that pass are cross-evaluated with the pv2 within-decision gate (scripts/cross_eval_pv2.py on the pv2 test decisions); among passing arms the one with the lowest validation BCE (not test) goes to a powered e2e screen inside planner_pv2_b_fix, predeclared separately. A failed bar is recorded, not retuned.

config.note: Predeclared 2026-11-07 before any training (Jerry: 'Yea both - tile based features or a CNN like AlphaGo is also interesting to get board state'; follows the model audit: who-wins/turns-left heads from the shengji findings, tile tokens from Settlers-RL, board planes from AlphaGo/Catanatron's board tensor). Reference result on the same test set: value-v2-100k-aug-b AUC .7715. Ultra (MPS available).
